import gzip

GZIP_MAGIC = b'\x1f\x8b'

def body_bytes(resp):
    raw = resp.content
    return gzip.decompress(raw) if raw[:2] == GZIP_MAGIC else raw

import json
import httpx
from http_utils.decompress import body_bytes

FEED_URL = 'https://feed.example-procurement.eu/notices'
HEADERS = {'User-Agent': 'tender-sieve/0.1 (+https://github.com/example/tender-sieve)'}

def fetch_day(day):
    url, params, notices = FEED_URL, {'date': day.isoformat()}, []
    while url:
        resp = httpx.get(url, params=params, headers=HEADERS)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = json.loads(body_bytes(resp))
        notices += body['notices']
        url, params = body.get('next'), None
    return notices

import re
import unicodedata

SUFFIXES = re.compile(r'\b(s\.?p\.?a|s\.?r\.?l|gmbh|ltd|sa)\.?$', re.I)

def normalize_buyer(name: str) -> str:
    name = SUFFIXES.sub('', name).strip(' ,')
    name = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', name).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode()
    return ' '.join(name.lower().split())

files.src/store_sqlite/db.py:
import sqlite3

def open_db(path='data/raw.db'):
    con = sqlite3.connect(path)
    con.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notices (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, published TEXT, xml BLOB)')
    con.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS by_published ON notices (published)')
    return con

def save(con, notice_id, published, xml):
    con.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO notices VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (notice_id, published, xml))

files.docs/dedup-design.md:
# Deduplication design

## Scope
A duplicate is a notice for a tender that was already published, by the same source or another one.

## Title similarity threshold
Title pairs are accepted at trigram similarity 0.82. On the hand-labelled March sample of 600 pairs, 0.82 kept false merges under 1% while still catching titles retyped with abbreviations; 0.75 merged distinct lots of framework agreements.

import gzip
import json

def write_groups(groups, path):
    with gzip.open(path, 'wt') as f:
        for g in groups:
            pairs = [{'left': p.left, 'right': p.right, 'reason': p.reason} for p in g['pairs']]
            f.write(json.dumps({'source_ids': g['source_ids'], 'pairs': pairs}) + '\n')
